profile.headline: Android Developer || Kotlin || MVVM || Jetpack Components
profile.summary: Enthusiastic technical professional with complete understanding of entire software development lifecycle. Innovative thinker with sound judgment and resourceful approach to problem-solving. Intelligent and hardworking Mobile App Developer with background of 7 years in IT. Highly educated and committed to creating dynamic apps for Android environment.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
-Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using Spring Boot to support front-end functionalities.
-Designed and implemented scalable database schemas in MongoDB, utilizing Spring Data MongoDB for seamless integration.
-Built dynamic and responsive user interfaces with React and Next.js, leveraging server-side rendering (SSR) for enhanced performance and SEO.
-Integrated the Next.js front-end with the Spring Boot back-end, ensuring robust and efficient data flow.
-Managed application state using React Hooks and Context API for a predictable and maintainable state logic.
-Implemented secure authentication and authorization mechanisms using Spring Security and JWT.
-Collaborated within an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver features iteratively, participating in sprint planning and daily stand-ups.
-Utilized Git for version control and collaborated with the team through pull requests and code reviews.
-Styled components using Tailwind CSS to create modern and consistent user experiences across the application.
-Containerized the application using Docker for streamlined development and deployment processes.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
-Architected and implemented high-performance RESTful APIs using Spring Boot and Kotlin to efficiently serve data to the front-end application.
-Crafted dynamic, user-centric interfaces using React and Next.js, employing server-side rendering (SSR) to achieve superior performance and search engine optimization (SEO).
-Fortified the application with end-to-end security, implementing authentication and authorization protocols with Spring Security and JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
-Developed and managed Docker containers for the application, ensuring consistency across development, testing, and production environments.
- Engineered robust and scalable NoSQL data models in MongoDB, integrating them with the back-end via Spring Data MongoDB to ensure optimal query performance. 
- Crafted dynamic, user-centric interfaces using React and Next.js, employing server-side rendering (SSR) to achieve superior performance and search engine optimization (SEO). 
- Orchestrated the seamless integration between the Next.js front-end and the Kotlin-based Spring Boot back-end, establishing a reliable and efficient communication layer. 
- Implemented modern state management solutions in React using Hooks and Context API, simplifying data flow and enhancing component reusability. 
- Fortified the application with end-to-end security, implementing authentication and authorization protocols with Spring Security and JSON Web Tokens (JWT). 
- Maintained high standards of code quality and team collaboration through disciplined use of Git, including feature branching, pull requests, and peer code reviews. 
- Utilized Tailwind CSS to rapidly build and style responsive, modern UIs with a utility-first approach. 
Skills: Spring Boot · Kotlin · React · Next.js · MongoDB · RESTful APIs · Full-Stack Development · Git · Docker · JavaScript · Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
-Programming application features in Kotlin.
-Refactored old code to decouple views from business logic using MVVM.
-Assisted in assessing and optimizing designs through review, and analysis to ensure optimal user experiences for all device types.
-Worked closely with platform and API teams to define the underlying interfaces that support projects.
-Developed custom and compound views to match UI/UX specifications.
-Used RecyclerView to display all list information inside of the application to the user.
-Implemented databinding with binding adapters.
-Worked closely with the UX design team to iterate designs in to living presentation code.
-Implemented a swipe functionality for RecyclerViews using ItemTouch helper.
-Programmed code in Kotlin language to perform Restful API calls using Retrofit
-Worked with Coroutines.
-Utilized Android SDK and supporting development devices.
-Worked with a Room database.
-Made use of NavGraph XML resource.
-Utilized two-way data binding to communicate between ViewModel and XML files.
positions.insights: XML, Mobile Application Development and +9 skills

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
-Programming application features in Java.
-Customized List Views, Spinners, Adapters, Table Layouts, etc.
-Designed screens using MVP pattern for the application with Android Studio IDE.
-Followed Agile methodology with Test Driven Development for implementing the application.
-Worked with Jenkins Continuous Integration server and used it to test on real devices.
-Improved performance on back-end integration by transitioning to Retrofit and parsing JSON objects with GSON.
-Implemented the best practices for Android mobile development with their main components: Activities, Services, Content Providers and Broadcast Receivers.
-Implemented local database using SQLite.
-Assisted in assessing and optimizing designs through review, and analysis to ensure optimal user experiences for all device types.
-Worked closely with platform and API teams to define the underlying interfaces that support projects.
-Developed custom and compound views to match UI/UX specifications.
